recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core source fix is needed for FHIR-20399; any further concern about historical STU3 downloadable archives would be release-archive maintenance rather than a change to the current FHIR source.
issue_request: FHIR-20399 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from STU3 asking to correct the v3/STU3 fhir-base.xsd dateTime regex so it matched the datatype-page regex and required a UTC offset whenever a full time is supplied.
initial_application: Git history contains explicit commit 20f1fafd1524580a9c4872dc63ce10a468f44b41, titled "FHIR-20399 Correction to v3 schema dateTime regex", which changed source/datatypes/primitives.xml, the primitive datatype source used for generated schema regexes.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread confirms the mismatch was specific to the STU3 schema and that R4 already had the required-offset behavior. Later dateTime regex work, especially FHIR-38735, refined the accepted current regex so date-only values remain valid while offsets are restricted to full times. FHIR-14094 was an earlier same-family STU3 schema mismatch report and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/datatypes/primitives.xml dateTime regex accepts partial dates, rejects full dateTimes without an offset, and accepts full dateTimes with Z or numeric offsets. The current checkout does not contain an authoritative checked-in fhir-base.xsd to patch; checked-in schema files are templates/generated artifacts, while the primitive source already reflects the accepted behavior.
